name: Grandmother Spider - Major Boon
text:
Grandmother Spider rejoices in freedom and tricks those who would limit it.

Any time you would become Grabbed, Immobilized, or Restrained, attempt a DC 10 Flat check. On a success, you ignore the effect, and the originator of the effect becomes grabbed, immobilized, or restrained instead. If this simply causes a creature to grab itself, it can usually Escape as a free action, but it might be stuck if it tried to immobilize you in other ways.
